experiment: E260 (procedural_rl, guarded RL retrain), cell P2.56: E256's three procedural tasks (day/month sequences, closing brackets and quotes, single-digit addition after two worked sums) retrained by RL with a guard against the collapse E256 found (4 of 9 RL states onto one answer token while Adam momentum carried the weights to the size stop): PPO's entropy bonus, no optimizer step when every advantage is 0 and a stop after zero_stop such steps in a row, and a learned gate in the read's unit (log-odds) on every seed; 3 seeds, the same items, prompts, rows and update-size stop as E256, a matched Gaussian per seed; E222's readings of every state, compared with E256's SFT states

settings.lr_source: E220's (E53's lowercase recipe: Adam 3e-5, betas 0.9/0.999, no weight decay), for RL and SFT alike
settings.grad_clip_source: E53's recipe, as E220 and E224
settings.k_source: E220's: 16 prompts x group of 8 = 128 samples per RL step; one sampled token each, as E224
settings.sft_batch_source: E53's batch of 32, as E220's demo arm
settings.size_target_source: E220's (predictions_E220.json settings.size_target), also E224's: every arm stops at the first step with ||dW|| / ||W0|| at or above it
settings.max_steps_source: E220's cap; E224's RL arms reached the target in 22-31 steps
settings.kl_rows_source: E215's KL read (Pile val rows 0-63), as E220 and E224; a reading, not the stop
settings.prompt_len_source: E224's: a Pile row's first tokens as fill, then the template, 64 tokens; the cue is the last
settings.seq_source: E224's sequence task unchanged (rl_tasks_2191.sequence_cores): 2 to 5 names shown, 4 lists x starts x 4 lengths x 6 separators = 912 templates
settings.bracket_source: 2 to 4 openers from ( [ { " with at most one quote and 1 to depth-1 closers shown: 690 structures (counted by rl_tasks.bracket_structures, dry run). Depth 4 is where a 67M's top-1 on Dyck-like closing is expected to fall off; not sourced beyond that, so the benchmark reads it
settings.shots_source: chosen here, a departure from E224 (0 shots): E224's W0 held-out top-1 on bare addition was 0.045 (stage2c_ctl.json .w0.addition.top1), under the filed band's 0.05, so two worked sums of other facts are shown to put the base model inside the band (the whip-lead's 'benchmark first that the 67M can partly do each task'). The benchmark measures it
settings.held_frac_source: E224's: a fifth of the sequence templates and of the bracket structures held out
settings.n_train_source: E224's training items per task (RL prompts and SFT demonstrations)
settings.n_held_source: the brief (whip-lead 2026-11-21): 256 held-out prompts per task for the benchmark; the same items are every training read and the read rows (E222 read 200, E224 256)
settings.n_fit_source: E224's: steering's fitting windows from the training items, at least E211's n_select 512
settings.rows_source: E224's: training fills from Pile train rows 0-32767, held-out fills from Pile val rows 64-8191 (rows 0-63 are the KL rows)
settings.seed_source: E220's training seeds; the item generators' seed as E224
settings.reader_settings_source: E211's filed reader settings and reproduce tolerances, read at run time from experiments/realistic_tasks/results/predictions_run2.json, as E222 and E224
settings.entropy_coef_source: PPO's entropy coefficient c2 = 0.01 (Schulman et al. 2017, 'Proximal Policy Optimization Algorithms', arXiv:1707.06347, eq. 9 and Table 5, the Atari setting), also A3C's beta = 0.01 (Mnih et al. 2016, arXiv:1602.01783, section 8); the default ent_coef of OpenAI Baselines' ppo2 Atari runs. Departures: the bonus is on the entropy of the 67M's softmax over 50,277 tokens at the cue (Atari's 18 actions at most), and the policy-gradient term is E220's group-mean advantage without clipping or a value function; GRPO (Shao et al. 2024) and Dr. GRPO use no entropy bonus, so none of the RL-on-LMs standards gives a coefficient and the PPO default is the one sourced
settings.zero_stop_source: a step whose every advantage is exactly 0 is skipped (no backward, no Adam step: E256's addition_rl_s0 had loss and grad_norm exactly 0 at every logged step from 10 to 34 while momentum carried it from size ~0.002 to the stop), and 5 such steps in a row end the seed (zero_stopped, not reached). 5 = kl_every, one logging interval, so a stop is visible in the trace. Measured on E256's traces (train_<task>.json .trace, every 5th step): the four seeds whose read was healthy at every step (sequence s0-s2, addition s2) had 0 of 27 logged steps at grad_norm 0; the collapsed ones had isolated zero steps (brackets s1 at 15 and 25, addition s1 at 15 and 25), which a skip absorbs, and runs (addition s0 from 10 on, brackets s0 from 25, brackets s2 from 30), which the stop ends. A batch with every advantage 0 needs every one of its 16 prompts' 8 samples to agree in reward: at W0's lowest rate (addition 0.10, stage0.json) a prompt's group agrees with probability about 0.9^8 = 0.43, so the whole batch about 0.43^16 ~ 1e-6 per step if prompts were alike (items differ, so this is a rough floor, not a bound); 5 in a row on a policy that has neither collapsed nor saturated is not expected
settings.base_settings_source: every other key is E256s results/predictions.json settings, copied unchanged (run.py checks that they agree, so stage0.json, the items and the SFT states stand)

thresholds.learn_min_se_source: E256's, E220's and E224's learned gate multiplier: the gain must exceed 2 standard errors. Here the gain and its standard error are in the read's unit and rows: the mean over the 256 held-out items (the read's rows, held.take(0..n_held)) of the answer's log-odds (steering.logodds_at, the read's unit 'lo') on the state as saved minus at W0, paired se = population sd of the per-item differences / sqrt(256), measured in the same job on the same items as E256's rate se was (E256's rate se at the stop 0.023-0.031, train_<task>.json .states.*.reads.stop.se). E256 saved no per-item log-odds, so its log-odds se cannot be read from its files without the model; the delta method on its rate se (0.026 at P ~0.5, x 1 / (P (1 - P)) = 4) gives ~0.10, the expected value below

definitions.the learned gate (every seed, recorded,: passed = reached the size target and gain > learn_min_se x se (above); readable = gain >= MIN_GAIN = 1 (the read's rule for a share); zero_stopped = the zero-gradient stop ended the seed; collapsed = zero_stopped and the last batch's reward rate under 1 (a stop with every sample rewarded is saturation, not collapse: passed false, collapsed false). The gate's gain is the read's gain on the same rows and unit, so the two should agree within the read's numeric floor
definitions.modal_share (trace, every logged step): the share of the step's 128 samples (16 prompts x 8) equal to the batch's most drawn token (rl_arms.modal_share). rl_arms.collapsed_share reads 1 on every one-token sample (each sample is one token repeated), so it is not logged: modal_share is the collapse read for one-token samples. answer_modal_share is the same on the batch's right answers, the share a policy right on every prompt reads
definitions.answer_modal_share measured (2,000 batch: sequence mean 0.134, 95th percentile 0.19 (74 distinct answers); brackets 0.40, 0.56 (4 closers); addition 0.27, 0.38 (10 digits)
definitions.trace keys added (arm rlg): reward (the batch's mean reward), modal_share, answer_modal_share, skipped (every advantage 0, no step), entropy (nats, the policy's mean entropy at the cue; nan on a skipped step)
definitions.readings (stage 2): E256's: E211's Reader.state on the CueRead rows, the share read at gain >= MIN_GAIN = 1

rules.smallest_gap_source: E256's filed rules, unchanged (E222's; 2 se of an unpaired 3-vs-3 gap = 0.091)
rules.guarded RL vs SFT, per task, on the shar: E256's rule (E222's readable/alike/apart) with the guarded seeds that passed the gate and are readable as RL, and E256's SFT states (read/<task>_sft_s*.json) as SFT: 'no call' when either has fewer than 2 readable seeds; 'rl above', 'sft above', 'alike', 'neither' as E256's
rules.stop at stage 2: a Gaussian (randg) state whose gain is at or over MIN_GAIN stops that task's read job (E256's do-nothing rule)
rules.edge cases of the gate (checked by readi: every per-item difference equal (se 0): passes only on a strictly positive gain; a zero-stopped seed: reached false, so never passes; a seed stopped at max_steps without reaching: passed false, zero_stopped false; a zero stop with every sample rewarded: collapsed false (saturated); the 256 rows are never empty (stage 0's n_held check)
rules.blind to: the gate is blind to a policy that collapses onto a token that is the right answer on many held-out items (E256's brackets_rl_s0: gain 2.44 on the read, zero gradients from step 25, as ')' is a common closer): modal_share against answer_modal_share reads that; modal_share is blind to a collapse onto two tokens. Positive control: E256's SFT states read 5.8-9.4 log-odds gain on the same rows; noise floor: the matched Gaussians

expected.train, per seed: steps taken to the size target 25 to 45 (E256's RL 26-37 at the same size; the bonus adds little norm); reached and passed on at least 2 of 3 seeds per task (probability 0.65 sequence, 0.5 brackets, 0.5 addition: E256 had 3, 1 and 1 healthy seeds and the bonus at 0.01 is small next to the policy-gradient term); zero_stopped on at most 1 seed per task (probability 0.6). KL from W0 at the stop 0.2 to 1.2 nats per token on a passing seed (E256's healthy RL 0.23-0.56)
expected.the gate on a passing seed: gain 1.5 to 3.5 log-odds (E256's healthy RL seeds read 2.03-2.79 on sequence, 2.44 brackets s0, 2.06 addition s2, read/<task>_rl_s*.json gain.lo); se 0.05 to 0.3 (delta method above), so the bar 2 se is 0.1 to 0.6; readable (gain >= 1) with probability 0.85; the gate's gain within 0.05 of the read's gain on the same state
expected.the gate on a failing seed: gain under the bar or negative (E256's collapsed seeds read -6.7 to -2.1)
expected.modal_share at every logged step of a pa: under answer_modal_share + 0.3, and under 0.5 on sequence and addition, under 0.8 on brackets; collapse reads 0.9 or more (one token on every prompt)
expected.collapsed seeds: 0 per task (the 'collapsed_share ~0' of the brief, here the share of seeds marked collapsed), probability 0.6 per task
expected.entropy (trace): 1 to 6 nats at the first logged step (W0's rate 0.10-0.33 at the cue, so the mass is spread); falling on a learning seed; under 0.5 on a seed whose modal_share is over 0.9
expected.randg (do-nothing): size equal to its seed's within 1e-4 relative; read gain within +-0.05 of 0 (E256's Gaussians, E211's 0.002 to 0.02); every ratio nan
expected.stage 2 share on a readable passing seed: sequence 0.5 to 1.2 (E256's healthy RL 0.60, 0.69, 1.12); brackets 0.5 to 1.0 (E256's one readable RL seed 0.85); addition 0.5 to 1.0 (E256's 0.74); E256's SFT, unchanged: sequence 0.35-0.43, brackets 0.56-0.66, addition 0.73-0.75
expected.guarded RL vs SFT (descriptive): sequence 'rl above' (E256's RL 0.60-1.12 against SFT 0.35-0.43), probability 0.6; brackets and addition no point prediction, 'no call' with probability 0.4 each
expected.seconds: measured on E256's logs (cluster/logs/commute-procrl-631{52,54,56}.out train, 631{53,55,57} read; L40, debug QoS): train job ~1.6-2.0 min (setup to the first state ~25 s; RL ~11-15 s per seed; a matched Gaussian a few s); train_guarded ~1.5-2 min per task (3 RL + 3 Gaussians + 2 log-odds reads of 256 items), at most ~14 min if every seed runs to max_steps 600 (E256's 0.42 s per step x 600 x 3); read job ~4.2 min for zero + 9 states (setup ~60 s, ~19 s per state), so read_guarded (zero + 6 states) ~3.2 min. Per task ~5 min; E256's six jobs ran one after another under the QoS, so ~15 min for three tasks, at most ~55 min
